title.suggested: Tom Allen and Mike McCoole Matched for a Second Fight

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Mike McCoole and Tom Allen were matched for $2,500 a side, to fight in four months within fifty miles of Cincinnati, with preliminaries arranged at Hennesy's saloon.

metadata.notes: The masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, July 10, 1869.' It was the Missouri Republican until 1888, not the St. Louis Republic.

facts.fact: A match was made between Tom Allen and Mike McCoole for $2,500 a side, to be fought in four months within fifty miles of Cincinnati; the preliminaries were arranged at Hennesy's saloon, Fourth and Morgan, St. Louis
places: Hennesy's saloon, Fourth and Morgan, St. Louis
within fifty miles of Cincinnati, Ohio

notes: The item says Allen was present at the meeting, but the Democrat of July 13 (article 339) says he was absent, said to be sick. Tom Kelley appeared for McCoole; Gallagher and Looney were present.
